item.title: Florida appeals court overturns $2,675 monthly alimony after a 249-day marriage
item.description: A recent decision by a Florida appeals court reversed an alimony order for a short marriage lasting 249 days. The court found insufficient evidence regarding the former wife's need for financial support. The trial court had awarded nine months of temporary alimony based on prior cases instead of specific proof. The appeals court emphasized the importance of individual cases and relevant evidence in such rulings. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Florida opens $191.8M water plant to protect the Matanzas River and conserve drinking water
item.description: St. Johns County Utilities officials celebrated the completion of the State Road 207 Water Reclamation Facility. This facility, costing $191.8 million, will treat wastewater and provide reclaimed water for irrigation purposes. The project aims to reduce dependence on the Floridan Aquifer, especially during ongoing drought conditions. Capacity of the facility can be expanded to meet future demand while preventing nutrient pollution in local waters. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Texas Supreme Court to decide if city can seize land for a privately run golf facility
item.description: The Texas Supreme Court will examine an eminent domain case involving Westworth Village's attempt to acquire land from Jim Burgess for a golf facility. Following a previous ruling that deemed the taking unconstitutional on public use grounds, the case delves into the legality of local governments appropriating private property for private enterprise projects. item.description: Donald Trump atribuyó los disturbios en Francia a la inmigración, sin aportar pruebas, y pidió cerrar las fronteras. Los saqueos y destrozos del sábado dejaron unos 1.500 comerciantes afectados y daños estimados en cientos de millones de euros, según un balance inicial del sector. El ministerio del Interior reportó unas 1.800 personas detenidas y más de 500 policías, gendarmes y bomberos heridos, en cifras provisionales. item.description: En la carrera por la colonización de la Luna , hay algo que China ha conseguido y que Estados Unidos aún no ha podido lograr: tomar muestras de su lado oculto. item.title: Russia sold Alaska for peanuts. Now it guards America against Moscow
item.description: In 1867, Russia sold Alaska to the United States for $7.2 million, reflecting strategic concerns. The decision stemmed from fears of potential conflict with Britain during the Crimean War. Subsequent discoveries of natural resources transformed Alaska's economic importance significantly over the years. Alaska emerged as a crucial military platform for the United States against the Russian Far East. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Rapid coastal erosion threatens coastal homes and economies, and as Super El Niño rounds the corner, a town is reckoning with the reality of climate crisis San Clemente is one of southern California’s most picture-perfect beach towns – a capital of American surf culture since the 1950s. item.title: A tiny patch could help rescuers perform CPR better; student invention wins $10,000
item.description: Four University of Washington students have developed CPRight, a wallet-sized patch that uses LED lights to guide rescuers during CPR. The device provides real-time feedback on chest compression depth and rate without requiring additional equipment. The invention won the $10,000 undergraduate first prize at the 2026 Collegiate Inventors Competition, which also recognised innovations in cancer treatment, rehabilitation and neurological monitoring. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: If Trump fells 430 trees in the middle of a golf course, do they make a sound?
item.description: In attempting to turn a public space in DC into an enclave for elites, Trump is moving the US capital closer to Graceland When is a tree not a tree? When it’s an obstacle to a par-3. If a tree falls in the middle of a golf course, does it make a sound? Yeah, probably. I wasn’t there, but I have to assume, based on my limited knowledge of the laws of physics. What I do know is that Donald Trump’s crusade to clear more than 400 trees for the purposes of redeveloping East Potomac Golf Links into a championship-level course isn’t happening. For now.
